jobs.title: Hardware/System/Software Engineers
jobs.description:
Summary:

We are looking for talented engineers to joint the team. Engineers have vital roles in driving technology advancement and product success with the internal teams and external teams at every stage of technology research, hardware and software design and development. The engineers will need to choose one of the primary technical focuses -- *hardware engineering focus, system engineering focus, or software engineering focus*, while learning from other technical areas in this exciting wireless system development field. The candidates are expected have a high level of professional qualifications in one of three major technical fields.

**Key Responsibilities**:

Participate in technology Research and Development (R&D). technology specification design and development, product software and hardware design and development

Participate in every stage of the technology R&D, including algorithm design, specification development, hardware and software design and development, prototyping, data analysis and other product development tasks

Experience industrial customer-centric methodology in technology and product development; Understand the customers’ requirements, identify the features of the technology and product to meet the customers’ essential needs, design the product according to customers’ expectations

Design specifications, algorithms and structures, evaluate and improve the designs to ensure the the technology meets all requirements; Ensure the quality of the technology and product by teamwork; Follow development procedure and execute the workflow

High level of organizational skills to interact with both internal team members and external collaborators at every stage of algorithm design, hardware design, software design, testing, manufacturing, and customer support, to ensure delivery of the product

Work closely with collaborators to optimize the product in alignment with industrial standards; Work closely with the customer support and marketing team to identify the key issues and make the necessary improvements according to customer feedback

**Qualifications**:

BS/MS/PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or related Engineering and Science fields

Professional qualifications of teamwork, detail-oriented, procedure compliance, strong learning ability, strong ability of adaptation, multitasking and prioritization

Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, highly motivated, excellent written and verbal communication abilities; Experience of delivering high-quality technology and products to achieve customer satisfaction

Work experience in one or multiple technical focused fields -- hardware engineering, system engineering, or software engineering. The engineer/intern will choose one focused engineering area, and work with team members in other engineering areas:

*Hardware engineering focus:*

Experience of either digital hardware or analog/RF hardware development; digital hardware experience includes FPGA/ASIC implementation of signal processing algorithms, RTL design verification and UVM testbench development, pipelining and latency optimization, and ASIC physical design

Analog/RF hardware experience includes the development of MIMO antenna arrays, RF upconverter and downconverter designs, power amplifier designs, low-noise amplifier and analog beamformer development

Experience of digital front-end and mixed signal design, including digital sampling rate adjustment, digital up-conversion and down-conversion, digital pre-distortion, digital beamforming and hybrid digital analog beamforming

Experience of wireless PHY hardware development integrating the digital front with PHY digital implementation, the RF subsystem, and the antenna arrays. Experience of FPGA and multi-core CPU integration and optimization.

*System engineering focus:*

Proficient in simulation evaluation of algorithms given 5G system specifications; proficient in simulation platform development to evaluate the critical algorithms together with the hardware engineering team; proficient in machine learning techniques to evaluate algorithms with the software engineering team

Experience in 3GPP specifications with an in-depth understanding of critical physical channels and signaling; experience in developing algorithms across digital PHY receivers and digital and analog front end; experience in 3GPP L2/L3 specifications to evaluate the scheduling algorithms and algorithms in upper layer protocol stacks

Experience in optimizing the algorithms based on the hardware constraints in practical engineering systems; knowledge of hardware timing cycles, algorithm hardware and timing complexities, and methods to reduce the algorithm complexity in hardware

Understanding of wireless receiver design principles and general methods; strong mathematical and theoretical capabilities in algorithm design and evaluation, including probability, signal detection and estimation, matrix theory and optimization

*Software engineering focus:*

Strong knowledge of software protocol stack development in wireless networks; understanding of wireless network architecture, scheduling algorithms, spectrum management techniques, routing algorithms, security and encryption methods

Knowledge and experience of cloud development, GIS development and mobile app development, with hands-on experience of mainstream software development environment in cloud database, GIS platform, web app, and mobile app development

Knowledge and experience of machine learning and deep learning algorithm design and model training in object recognition, image feature extraction, scene reconstruction, robotics navigation, path planning and related technologies

Knowledge and experience of mathematical methods in statistics, algorithms, linear algebra, graphs, and implementation of mathematical models to address practical engineering challenges

Pay: $70,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote
